Message:
I heard about a witch
who can breathe life into
just about anything.
She might be the one who
can restore the flower.

I wasted no time heading
towards her house,
only to find a girl collapsed
on the floor inside.
“Hey, you okay?”

She didn’t respond to my voice,
yet particles of light kept
scattering from her fingertips.
It’s like her power’s
gone out of control.

Haah...guess I’ve got
no other choice.

“I can’t believe you
saw me like that.
It’s so embarrassing...”

Now looking a little better
from when I found her,
the girl let out a weak smile
from atop the bed.

“Thank you for saving me.
Are you a witch too?”

I gave my arm a quick cut.
When she saw the wound
immediately close up,
her smile darkened.
“You...can’t die.”

“I am an immortal witch,
after all.”

“...You know...they say
I’m going to die soon.”

Particles of light were
still scattering from
her trembling fingertips.

It finally dawned on me—
her life essence was
the very light spilling out of her.
“What a pretty light.”

“A witch’s power comes
from the heart.
Such beautiful light can
only be born from a heartfelt
wish that’s just as beautiful.”
Unlike mine.

I caught the girl gazing at me
with eyes full of wonder.

Before long, that darkened face
of hers was beaming with
childlike happiness.
“You think so too, huh!”

That’s how I met the girl
who houses the essence of life
in her fingertips—Yubera.
